doc: `CPUID.01H:ECX.AES[25]`, independent of psABI levels.
`CPUID.01H:EDX.CLFSH[19]`; independent of SSE2 and all psABI levels.
Independent `CPUID.01H:ECX.PCLMULQDQ[1]`; absent from psABI v3.
OS-enabled XSAVE state management (`CPUID.OSXSAVE`); AVX also needs XCR0 state at runtime.
AVX-512 foundation; execution also requires OS-enabled opmask and ZMM XCR0 state.
AVX-512 128/256-bit vector-length forms.
RDTSCP timing and processor-ID instruction.
FS/GS base register instructions; execution also requires enabled `CR4.FSGSBASE`.
Hardware random-number instruction; callers must check the carry flag.
INVPCID translation invalidation instruction; execution requires its privilege/state preconditions.
Write-prefetch instruction capability.
Hardware entropy-seed instruction; callers must check the carry flag.
WAITPKG timed wait capability; execution also depends on OS wait-control policy.
AMX tile state and memory instructions; execution requires enabled tile XCR0/XFD state and configured tiles.
AMX integer tile dot products.
AMX BF16 tile dot products.
AMX FP16 tile dot products.
Intel APX foundation; REX2 EGPR forms require OS-enabled APX state.
MONITOR/MWAIT instructions; execution requires the OS-enabled monitor facility and permitted privilege.
AVX-512 dword/qword operations; execution requires foundation vector state.
AVX-512 byte/word operations and wide mask registers; execution requires foundation vector state.
AVX-512 conflict detection and vector leading-zero counts; execution requires foundation vector state.
